title: Ergodicity of the regular tetrahedron billiard
plain: The regular tetrahedron does not tile space, so its billiard cannot be unfolded into a straight-line flow on a torus. Is a billiard ball in it ergodic?
math: Prove or disprove that the billiard flow in a regular tetrahedron in $\mathbb R^3$ is ergodic with respect to Liouville measure on the unit tangent bundle.
